book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
title: 切比雪夫(Chebyshev)不等式
stem_md:
设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n, b_1, b_2, \cdots, b_n$ 满足 $a_1 \leq a_2 \leq \cdots \leq a_n$, $b_1 \leq b_2 \leq \cdots \leq b_n$, 则
$n \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k b_{n-k+1} \leq \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k \sum_{k=1}^{n} b_k \leq n \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k b_k$.
original_text_md:
切比雪夫(Chebyshev)不等式 设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n, b_1, b_2, \cdots, b_n$ 满足 $a_1 \leq a_2 \leq \cdots \leq a_n$, $b_1 \leq b_2 \leq \cdots \leq b_n$, 则
$n \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k b_{n-k+1} \leq \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k \sum_{k=1}^{n} b_k \leq n \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k b_k$.
